# weir log

<!-- Generated by `weir reference`. Do not edit: change the help text in src/main.rs and regenerate. -->

Show past sync runs and what each one changed.

```text
Show past sync runs and what each one changed

Usage: weir log [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --json
          Machine-readable output

  -n <COUNT>
          How many runs to show

          [default: 5]

      --all
          Also list repositories that were fetched and had not changed

  -q, --quiet
          Print errors only

      --slow
          Show the ten slowest repositories of each run instead

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
